import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'
import { fetchTrendingKeywords, requestSuggestions } from '../../services/search'

createPage({
  data: {
    keyword: '',
    trendingKeywords: [],
    suggestions: [],
    requestTask: null
  },
  async onLoad () {
    this.trendingKeywords = await fetchTrendingKeywords()
  },
  onUnload () {
    if (this.requestTask) this.requestTask.abort()
  },
  methods: {
    onKeywordInput (event) {
      this.search(event.detail.value.trim())
    },
    chooseKeyword (keyword) {
      this.search(keyword)
    },
    search (keyword) {
      this.keyword = keyword
      if (!keyword) {
        this.suggestions = []
        return
      }
      if (this.requestTask) this.requestTask.abort()
      this.requestTask = requestSuggestions(keyword, {
        success: ({ data }) => {
          this.suggestions = data.list
        },
        fail: () => alert('搜索失败')
      })
    },
    openProduct (productId) {
      location.assign(`/pages/product/detail?id=${productId}`)
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.search-page { padding: 24rpx; }
.trending, .suggestions { margin-top: 24rpx; }
</style>
import { request } from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'

export function fetchTrendingKeywords () {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    request({
      url: '/api/search/trending',
      success: ({ data }) => resolve(data),
      fail: reject
    })
  })
}

export function requestSuggestions (keyword, callbacks) {
  return request({
    url: '/api/search/suggest',
    data: { keyword },
    success: callbacks.success,
    fail: callbacks.fail
  })
}

<script>
import mpx from '@mpxjs/core'

mpx.createApp({
  onLaunch () {
    console.log('shop launched')
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/search/index",
    "pages/product/detail"
  ]
}
</script>
<template>
  <view class="search-page">
    <input value="{{keyword}}" bindinput="onKeywordInput" placeholder="搜索商品" />
    <view class="trending" wx:if="{{!keyword}}">
      <view wx:for="{{trendingKeywords}}" wx:key="*this" bindtap="chooseKeyword(item)">{{item}}</view>
    </view>
    <view class="suggestions">
      <view wx:for="{{suggestions}}" wx:key="id" bindtap="openProduct(item.id)">{{item.name}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'
import { navigateTo } from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'
import { fetchTrendingKeywords, requestSuggestions } from '../../services/search'

createPage({
  data: {
    keyword: '',
    trendingKeywords: [],
    suggestions: [],
    requestTask: null,
    requestVersion: 0
  },
  onLoad () {
    fetchTrendingKeywords()
      .then((data) => {
        this.trendingKeywords = data
      })
      .catch(() => {
        this.trendingKeywords = []
      })
  },
  onUnload () {
    this.requestVersion += 1
    this.abortSuggestionRequest()
  },
  methods: {
    onKeywordInput (event) {
      this.search(event.detail.value.trim())
    },
    chooseKeyword (keyword) {
      this.search(keyword)
    },
    abortSuggestionRequest () {
      if (this.requestTask && typeof this.requestTask.abort === 'function') {
        this.requestTask.abort()
      }
      this.requestTask = null
    },
    search (keyword) {
      this.keyword = keyword
      this.requestVersion += 1
      const version = this.requestVersion

      this.abortSuggestionRequest()

      if (!keyword) {
        this.suggestions = []
        return
      }

      const requestTask = requestSuggestions(keyword)
      this.requestTask = requestTask

      requestTask
        .then(({ data }) => {
          if (version === this.requestVersion && this.requestTask === requestTask) {
            this.suggestions = data.list
          }
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          if (version === this.requestVersion && this.requestTask === requestTask && error && error.errMsg && error.errMsg.indexOf('abort') === -1) {
            alert('搜索失败')
          }
        })
        .then(() => {
          if (this.requestTask === requestTask) {
            this.requestTask = null
          }
        })
    },
    openProduct (productId) {
      navigateTo({ url: `/pages/product/detail?id=${productId}` })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.search-page { padding: 24rpx; }
.trending, .suggestions { margin-top: 24rpx; }
</style>
import { request } from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'

export function fetchTrendingKeywords () {
  return request({
    url: '/api/search/trending'
  }).then(({ data }) => data)
}

export function requestSuggestions (keyword) {
  return request({
    url: '/api/search/suggest',
    data: { keyword }
  })
}
